aboutGame.title: What is Welldweller?
paragraphs: Welldweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania from developer Kyle Thompson, published by Top Hat Studios and released on September 22, 2026. You play as Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a single matchstick, descending into a rotten kingdom of flooded wells, cisterns, and stone-lined pits where light and flame are both weapon and guide.

Progress in Welldweller comes from unlocking abilities, collecting trinkets, and learning the well's layered map. The game spans 13 bosses, 32 trinkets, and 20 spirits across PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch, and it rewards patient exploration and clean dodging over brute force.

modules.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to Welldweller's core movement, exploration, combat, healing, saving, and progression systems, so new players can start strong and avoid common early mistakes.

highlights.detail: Play the intro and read every prompt before you start exploring.
Rebind controls and set audio and subtitles to suit your setup.
Learn Glimmer's basic attack, dodge, and matchstick light.

Spend early resources on one offense and one defense upgrade.
Note locked doors and one-way drops for later backtracking.

items.question: What is Welldweller?
items.answer: Welldweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania from developer Kyle Thompson and publisher Top Hat Studios. You play as Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick, exploring a rotten kingdom of flooded wells while fighting bosses and collecting trinkets.

items.question: What platforms is Welldweller available on?
items.answer: Welldweller released on September 22, 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.

items.question: How many bosses are in Welldweller?
items.answer: There are 13 bosses in Welldweller, ranging from early gatekeepers that test dodge timing to optional hidden encounters and late-game phase-shifters.

items.question: How many trinkets and spirits does Welldweller have?
items.answer: Welldweller includes 32 trinkets and 20 spirits. Trinkets cover offense, defense, sustain, mobility, and luck, while spirits tie into the game's progression and world.

items.question: How long does Welldweller take to beat?
items.answer: Welldweller's length depends on how much you explore. A focused run is far shorter than a completionist run that chases all 32 trinkets, every named location, and both endings.

items.question: Is there a hard mode in Welldweller?
items.answer: Yes. Welldweller offers multiple difficulty tiers plus a hard mode, and the highest settings tighten the resource economy and punish sloppy positioning.
